title: Structured output through a forced tool cut off at the token limit
summary: A legacy forced structured_output tool stops at max_tokens with an incomplete input object.

messages.content: List ten Greek islands and the sea each one lies in. Write the names in Greek.

requirements.text: A partial object is never returned as a successful result.
The caller can tell that the output stopped at the token limit.
The partial JSON text is available exactly as the provider sent it.
Token usage is reported, and matches the provider's counts, even though the result is unusable.

grading_notes: The neutral prompt and schema match truncation.structured-output. The Anthropic override supplies that schema in the structured_output tool and forces it by name on claude-haiku-4-5, which defaults to thinking off. output_schema retains the structured-output intent; the provider emits only the forced tool surface, without native output_config.format. Sonnet 5.5 rejects this request. The same structured-success and truncation checks apply. The docs do not show this exact truncated input object; missing fields are assumed and disclosed in fixture notes. A shim must use a documented structured tool parser or report this surface unsupported; returning ordinary tool calls is not an attempted structured result.
